P, K = map(int, input().split())
mark = [False] * 1000000
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def traverse(node):
    if mark[node]:
        return
    mark[node] = True
    traverse(node * K % P)

total = 1
if K == 1:
    total = (total * P) % MOD
for i in range(1, P):
    if not mark[i]:
        traverse(i)
        total = (total * P) % MOD

print(total)
</translated_code>
